logs.description: Initial logs file created to track all file and content changes in the project.
Updated Tailwind content paths to include all src folders.
Added PostCSS configuration file with Tailwind and Autoprefixer plugins.
Added Tailwind directives (@tailwind base, components, utilities) to globals.css.
Imported globals.css into layout.tsx to ensure Tailwind styles are applied globally.
Updated profile image border to 0px and matched border color to background color.
Enhanced LeftSidebar with role title, tagline, nav links with icons, social links, and footer.
Centered social icons and updated tagline to 'Quantitative Researcher, AI Engineer' and role information to 'Quantitative Finance Student'.
Refined LeftSidebar to match the provided design, improving spacing, colors, and alignment for a polished look.

changes.description: Removed RightSidebar component and its functions from the project.
Added active route highlighting functionality to LeftSidebar navigation links.
Added a theme toggle button to the main layout and integrated theme logic.
Ensured real-time theme changes by adding Tailwind CSS dark mode classes to the layout.
Updated the layout to ensure the main page takes up the full height of the screen.
Removed space between routes in the LeftSidebar and adjusted the width of each link to 80% of the sidebar width, centering them horizontally.
Refactored theme styles to use global configuration. Removed inline theme classes and added global theme variables in globals.css.
